cost_model.basis: Fraction of initial risk (R), applied as a round-trip deduction from realized R. Chosen because Deriv synthetic-index live spread/commission quotes are not available to this session as a verifiable, citable data source; a risk-fraction model is the most transparent honest substitute and is applied identically and preregistered before any outcome is computed.

B_cost_sensitivity.finding: The flat conservative cost (0.10R per trade) consumes 134.8% of the 0.0742R average gross edge -- the edge is thinner than the cost applied to erase it. 66.0% of individual trades had a gross edge smaller than the flat 0.10R cost. No cost assumption was lowered to produce this finding; costs were fixed before any outcome was computed (preregistration commitment).
